mechanism: row-to-core balance / C13-C14 range-owner permutation (static workload-equivalent control)
hypothesis: Test whether a one-block range-owner rotation changes row/core workload balance for C13/C14. Static comparison shows the same per-block row-count multiset as R048; only block-to-row identity changes. Runtime or performance effect is unknown.
change: In ProcessWideLowPrecision, when rowCount == 128 and rowWidth == 16384, map blockIdx to (blockIdx + 1) % blockCount before calling the existing GetBalancedRowRange. This rotates contiguous row-range ownership by one logical block only for Canonical C13/C14. The range formula, row counts, row offsets, tiles, UB buffers, arithmetic, and reduction logic are unchanged.

trigger_scope.scope_note: The predicate is evaluated only in ProcessWideLowPrecision; other canonical shapes do not satisfy both dimensions. For blockCount=1 the permutation is necessarily identity.
